name: Rive Environment
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y xvfb libegl1 libopengl0 libx11-6 libgles2 libwayland-egl1 libxkbcommon0 && curl -fsSL https://releases.rive.app/cli/install.sh | sh && echo 'export PATH="/home/codespace/.rive/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc
postStartCommand: sudo mkdir -p /home/codespace/.config/rive/app.rive.cli && sudo cp -r /workspaces/rive-animations/.devcontainer/rive-auth/app.rive.cli/. /home/codespace/.config/rive/app.rive.cli/ && sudo chown -R codespace:codespace /home/codespace/.config/rive && npx http-server -p 8080 &

mkdir -p ~/.config/rive/app.rive.cli && while [ ! -d /workspaces/rive-animations/.devcontainer/rive-auth/app.rive.cli ]; do sleep 1; done && cp -r /workspaces/rive-animations/.devcontainer/rive-auth/app.rive.cli/. ~/.config/rive/app.rive.cli/ && npx http-server -p 8080 &
